cell.name: 3-5-6-7__near_boundary
cell.rationale: two internal reflections (partial or total, Fresnel-weighted) on the canonical column; its arcs end on exit TIR or path infeasibility; a pose 1e-3 inside the nearest validity gate (Snell/incidence), plus its mirror image outside

selection.method: bisected to a validity margin from the random cell's start
selection.outside_failure: internal ray does not reach face 6 from inside (reflection 2)

fresnel_transmission.basis: float64 evaluation of the same closed-form refraction/reflection chain from bit-identical JSON inputs: a few ulp per interface (1e-12 leaves ~1e3 ulp of room), times 1/(2 sqrt(d)) for the smallest Snell discriminant d of the pose, the derivative of the refracted cosine sqrt(d) (kinematic_atol)

valid.basis: exact boolean; the nearest gate internal_2_incidence_cosine has margin 0.001, far above the float64 rounding of a margin (~1e-15)
